posts.title: How we size a wedding bar
posts.excerpt: Guest count, ceremony timing, and cocktail mix — the three numbers that set your package band.
posts.body: Start with headcount, then hours of open pour, then how adventurous the menu is. Our drink calculator turns those into a package recommendation you can book from.

posts.title: What we bring vs what you provide
posts.excerpt: A clear split so planners are not guessing on ice, glassware, or power.
posts.body: We bring bartenders, bar toolkits, ice plans, and the cocktail program. Venue provides space, power access, and guest list timing. Package pages list inclusions line by line.
